en: The postcard front shows a tall lookout tower surrounded by green trees under a clear blue sky. The lower part of the tower is a rough stone cylinder that spirals upward, topped by a smoother concrete shaft and a green-roofed, enclosed observation deck. The back of the postcard is blank aside from standard postcard layout elements and a printed caption along the left edge.
